benchMoves.comment: Immersive Armors puts its Apotheus set on the Skyforge; the Skyforge keeps only the three sets below

world.comment: AlduinakWorldChanges.esp (9776cba3), merged as spec data. Its Creation Kit dropped the Warbirds Whiterun Metropolis.esp master and rewrote every cell it opened, so only the references are carried: the new ones here, the nudges under "moves", and one disable under "disableReferences". The section is plain data, edited by hand.

list.name: College of Winterhold or the Synod

disableReferences.comment: The beehives and Stonewall Terrace pieces the owner asked Graves to delete, the collision box left in the gateway of the iron gate in the Whiterun outer wall, and the ceiling rubble, the hall collapse and the collision box that block the Helgen keep escape tunnel (HelgenKeep01), whose opening quest never runs here. A Creation Kit deletion does not survive a rebuild, so they are listed here and come back Initially Disabled every run.

disableActors.comment: Every placed actor, living or dead, of every plugin before this one is Initially Disabled, and one with an enable parent gets the player as parent, opposite, so no quest or marker turns it back on. The server spawns none of them; the game would. except names actors to leave alone, by form key. A worldspace override added for their cells takes the fields of its last winner outside notFrom: DynDOLOD.esm is generated, and its own large references would make it a master.

races.comment: The playable races and their vampire forms lose every racial power the game hands a character (greater powers and the vampires' Hunter's Sight); only Khajiit Night Eye stays.
